-> ww gb1 gbN = (2).2.0

ww gb1 gbN = (2).3.0
............. ww gbN = (3) = chứa trong ww catbox0

ww gb0 gbN catbox1 = (3).1.0
ww gbN catbox1 = (4)
..........
=> ww catboxN = baseline N
